subject: ACME Health Tech — technical deep dive (ML/infra) — scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Dr. Lena Ruiz <lena.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Health Tech — next step: technical deep dive (ML/infra)

Hi Samir / Lena —

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand your use case and constraints. Quick recap: you’re interested in a production inference solution for triage scoring and clinical note summarization across ~200M monthly inference tokens, with a latency target of ~300ms p50 and strict PHI handling requirements.

Next recommended step: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams + our ML infra and solutions engineers to walk through architecture, dataset footprint, and performance expectations. Proposed agenda (flexible):
- 10 min intros & goals
- 15 min current architecture & data flow (ACME)
- 25–35 min Redwood runtime + quantization/latency plan + demo of live inferencing patterns
- 15 min integration/operational requirements (VPC, KMS, audit logs)
- 10–15 min open Q&A / next steps

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 23 Jun, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu 24 Jun, 09:00–10:30 PT

Please let me know which slot works best and who from your ML/infra/security team will join so we can include the right Redwood engineers (I’d like Camila Reyes and Dylan Brooks on the call). I’ve attached a short post-discovery summary and a mutual action plan that we can iterate on.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-post-discovery-summary.pdf, MAP-Acme-Health.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Lena Ruiz <lena.ruiz@acmehealth.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Health Tech — next step: technical deep dive (ML/infra)

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the clear agenda. Both slots could work on our side but I want to confirm attendance before locking it: I’ll have Dr. Lena Ruiz (Head of ML) and Marcus Lee (Cloud Infra lead) join. We may also loop in one of our security engineers depending on availability.

Pref: Wed 23 Jun, 10:00–11:30 PT if that still works.

Couple asks ahead of the deep dive:
- Can you confirm the Redwood team members who will attend and their focus areas?
- For the demo, can you show a similar workload (batch + streaming inference) and call out expected p50/p95 latency at 2–3K TPS?
- Any pre-read we should review?

Thanks — I’ll circulate a calendar invite once we confirm the final time.

Best,
Samir
Principal Product Manager
ACME Health Tech
samir.patel@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Dr. Lena Ruiz <lena.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@acmehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Health Tech — next step: technical deep dive (ML/infra)

Thanks, Samir — Wed 23 Jun 10–11:30 PT works for us and I’ve asked Camila (solutions) and Dylan (ML infra) to join. Alex Martinez will cover integration/ops items.

Quick attendee notes from Redwood:
- Camila Reyes (Solutions Engineer) — demo + integration patterns
- Dylan Brooks (ML Infrastructure) — runtime, batching, quantization, latency tuning
- Alex Martinez (Platform Engineer) — VPC, KMS, deployment/rollout patterns

We’ll aim to demo a mixed batch/stream workload and surface p50/p95 numbers for the model family we recommend (open-model variant) at different quantization profiles. I’ve attached an architecture diagram we’ll use as a reference.

Final agenda (brief):
1) Intro & goals (10m)
2) ACME current architecture (Lena) (15m)
3) Redwood runtime & demo (Camila) (30–35m)
4) Integration & security (Alex + Dylan) (20m)
5) Q&A and next steps (10–15m)

If you can share any constraints ahead of time (dataset size, SLOs, required certifications), that’ll let us tailor the deep dive. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the above.

I’ll send the calendar invite shortly and include the attached docs.

—
Marissa

Attachments: acme-arch-diagram.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 07:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Health Tech — next step: technical deep dive (ML/infra)

Marissa — I’m on for Wed at 10. I’ll cover the demo and bring the quantization comparisons + a short live run of a ~1k token prompt to show latency behavior.

Quick Q for the ACME thread (Samir/Lena): can you confirm the size of the largest nightly batch (approx records/day) and whether inference will be on-prem or in-cloud for the initial rollout? That affects how we size the demo environment.

—Camila
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
